nota: No es material de estudio. Es para escuchar las voces seguidas antes de generar los 16 guiones y comprobar que se distinguen entre si. El par de riesgo es narrador (Alistair) y gb-h-medio (Tom): dos britanicos de registro medio.

lineas.texto: Part One. You will hear three different extracts. There are two questions for each extract.
I read the studies and they moved me not at all. What moved me was running the thing for fourteen months.
Everyone assumes there was a moment and there was not. I had been reading about it for six years.
I was good at it, and that was the trouble. Being good at something is a trap nobody warns you about.
We have not read a book since March and everybody is considerably happier, which tells you something.
The hardest part was being the least experienced person in a room of people my own age.
I came out of it slightly annoyed, and it took me a while to work out why.
Twenty-six years in hospital administration, and then my hands started shaking.
They asked on the Monday and I said yes before the end of the call.
